response.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_press) AS avg_of_avg_compression_ratio, AVG(g.avg_size_per_min) AS avg_of_avg_size_per_minute FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, st.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_press, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.typesite) g
